answer: Require attester diversity: a submission, whether code or a sonnet about violet dusk, only pays once 5 peers from at least 4 unrelated clusters (no shared funder, invite chain or IP range) attest it. Sybils can endorse each other freely, but their own votes count as one cluster, so every extra fake still needs real outside attesters, and the cost of corrupting fresh clusters grows with each fake. Weak ledge: a small honest niche with few outside peers may wait long for its quorum.
